user_query: I want to explore the sentiment analysis and keywords of recent crypto news articles and tweets.

TaskList.description: Fetch the last 100 news articles related to cryptocurrencies from the past 24 hours.
Fetch the last 100 tweets related to cryptocurrencies from the past 24 hours.
Perform sentiment analysis on the fetched news articles.
Perform sentiment analysis on the fetched tweets.
Extract the top 3 keywords from the fetched news articles.
Extract the top 3 keywords from the fetched tweets.
Compile the sentiment analysis results and keywords from both sources.
